user.title: Log in to SE-Monitor
user.description:
1. Open [this Schneider login link]({login_url}) in your browser and sign in with your SE-Monitor account.
2. After signing in, your browser is sent to a `http://localhost/?code=...` page that will not load. That is expected.
3. Copy the full address from the browser's address bar and paste it below.

The link can only be used once; if it fails, close this dialog and start again.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to SE-Monitor again
reauth_confirm.description:
Your SE-Monitor login has expired.

1. Open [this Schneider login link]({login_url}) and sign in.
2. Paste the full `http://localhost/?code=...` address you are sent to below.

error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Start the login again with a fresh link.
error.invalid_url: That doesn't look like the redirected URL. It should start with http://localhost/?code=
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the SE-Monitor cloud.

abort.no_sites: No sites were found on this SE-Monitor account.
abort.wrong_account: You logged in with a different account than the one this entry was set up with.
